note: Re-judged under the D-10 corrected row 'Nonces used in IKEv2 MUST be randomly chosen, MUST be at least 128 bits in size'. The 128-bit floor, both directions: send, TestRFC7296EmittedNoncesAreAtLeast128Bits checks all six emitted nonces (IKE_SA_INIT Ni/Nr, Child SA rekey Ni/Nr, IKE SA rekey Ni/Nr off the wire) are >= 16 octets; receive, TestNonceLengthBounds accepts 16 and refuses 15 octets with ErrNonceTooShort. The randomness clause the span passes through is the verbatim text of RFC7296-2.10-4, whose own tagged units (engine/rfc7296_session_test.go) carry it; this row's units assert the floor alone, as the correction states. Record: GenerateNonce revert observed red, re-recorded for the new row text.
